criteria.rationale: The patient was 56 on the request date, exceeding the minimum age of 12.
The PA request is for chronic weight management.

The patient stopped the diet and exercise program and, at the most recent visit, explicitly reported not following a diet or exercise plan. No other ongoing or planned lifestyle modification was documented with Wegovy.
The latest structured BMI is 38.2 kg/m², above the 30 kg/m² threshold; a comorbidity is not required.

missing_requirements: Ongoing or planned lifestyle modification as an adjunct to Wegovy
